dialogue.content: お疲れさまです。よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for your time today. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: I look forward to our session as well.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、今日はご相談にお越しいただき、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Hello, thank you for coming in for a consultation today.

dialogue.content: まず最初に、年齢、性別、相談内容を教えてください
dialogue.English: First, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 45歳女性、子供のことで悩んでいます
dialogue.English: I’m a 45-year-old woman, and I’m worried about my child.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お子さんのどんなことでお悩みでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. What specifically about your child are you concerned about?

dialogue.content: 高校生の女が、ずっと朝起きれず遅刻していて、最近は登校もしなくなり退学になりそうなんです
dialogue.English: My high school daughter has been constantly unable to wake up in the morning and is always late. Recently, she stopped going to school altogether and is on the verge of having to drop out.

dialogue.content: 娘です
dialogue.English: She's my daughter.

dialogue.content: それはご心配ですね。学校に行かなくなったのは、どれくらいですか？
dialogue.English: That must be very worrying for you. How long has it been since she stopped going to school?

dialogue.content: 2週間くらい前からです
dialogue.English: It started about two weeks ago.

dialogue.content: なるほど・・・お母さまとして、とても心配だったり、腹が立ったりしますよね
dialogue.English: I understand... As a mother, you must feel very worried and perhaps frustrated.

dialogue.content: これまでは、どんなふうに対処なされていたのですか？ご苦労されましたよね
dialogue.English: How have you been dealing with this so far? It must have been quite a struggle for you.

dialogue.content: はい、本当に心配で、、何度も話そうとしたけどろくに返事もしません
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm so worried... I've tried to talk to her many times, but she barely responds.

dialogue.content: うんうん・・お嬢さんは、学校に行かない事をどんなふうにお考えなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see... What does your daughter think about not going to school?

dialogue.content: 2週間前までは、絶対卒業すると言っていたのに今はどうでもいいと
dialogue.English: Until two weeks ago, she was saying she would definitely graduate, but now she says she doesn't care.

dialogue.content: 学校の呼び出しにも行きません
dialogue.English: She won't even go when the school calls her in.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね行きたくない、とおっしゃっているんですねちなみに、お嬢さんは今何年生でしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. So she's saying she doesn't want to go. By the way, what grade is your daughter in?

dialogue.content: 2年生です
dialogue.English: She's a sophomore.

dialogue.content: 2週間以上前も、朝起きれなくて遅刻されていたそうですが、それはずっとそういう感じだったのでしょうか？それとも、ある一時期からそうなっていたようですか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned that even before these past two weeks, she had trouble waking up and was late. Has it always been like that, or did it start at a certain point?

dialogue.content: 2年生になった頃からずっとです
dialogue.English: It's been happening ever since she started her sophomore year.

dialogue.content: それまでは、普通に通っていらしたんですね…それは、お母様もとてもお困りですよね
dialogue.English: So she was attending school normally before that... This must be very troubling for you as her mother.

dialogue.content: そ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: はい病院にも行きましたが、心療内科は嫌だというので小児科に行き規律性調節障害と言われて薬ももらいましたが、飲みません
dialogue.English: Yes. We went to the hospital, but she refused to see a psychosomatic specialist, so we went to a pediatrician. She was diagnosed with orthostatic dysregulation and was prescribed medication, but she won't take it.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お嬢さんは、学校に行きたくないんですね…
dialogue.English: I see. So your daughter doesn't want to go to school...

dialogue.content: 行ったら楽しいみたいなんですけど
dialogue.English: But it seems like she has fun when she does go.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 今は学校から通信へ転校した方がいいと言われて
dialogue.English: Now the school is telling us it would be better for her to transfer to a correspondence course.

dialogue.content: もうどうでもいいと
dialogue.English: And she says she doesn't care anymore.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: どうでもいいというのは、お嬢さんがそう言われているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: When you say "doesn't care," is that what your daughter is saying?

dialogue.content: はいなので、このまま通信に転校しても、やれるのかなと
dialogue.English: Yes. So I'm wondering if she'll even be able to handle it if she transfers to a correspondence course.

dialogue.content: 心配です
dialogue.English: I’m worried.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お嬢さんは、「今の学校をやめたい」のか、「通信に行く」のか、「どうでもいい」のか、は、はっきりおっしゃっておられないんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So your daughter hasn't clearly stated whether she wants to "quit her current school," "go to a correspondence course," or if she "just doesn't care."

dialogue.content: そうですねでも、もう通信しか道はないんです
dialogue.English: That's right. But a correspondence course is the only option left.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。今の学校を続けるとしたら、どうなりそうなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. If she were to continue at her current school, what would likely happen?

dialogue.content: 進級は無理そうで、学校は留年はあまりさせないみたいなので転校するしかないと
dialogue.English: It seems advancing to the next grade is unlikely, and the school doesn't really let students repeat a year, so they say transferring is the only option.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。お母様としては、どんなふうにお考えなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. As her mother, what are your thoughts on this?

dialogue.content: 大学には行って欲しかったですが最近はもう、無理かなと、、、
dialogue.English: I wanted her to go to college, but lately I feel it might be impossible…

dialogue.content: 本人が幸せならいいのかなと思うんですけど、このまま幸せになれるのかなと心配です
dialogue.English: I think it's fine as long as she's happy, but I'm worried if she'll be able to find happiness like this.

dialogue.content: お母様は、それが心配なんですねお嬢さんは、この件についてはどんなふうにお考えなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: That's what you're worried about. What does your daughter think about all this?

dialogue.content: わからないです何も言わないです一応将来は美容の方に進みたいと先生には言ったみたいですけどこのままでは専門学校も何もやれないんじゃないかと思います
dialogue.English: I don't know. She won't say anything. Apparently, she told her teacher she wants to go into the beauty industry in the future, but at this rate, I don't think she'll be able to attend vocational school or anything.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。今日ご相談にお越しになるまでに、随分と苦しかったですよね・・・
dialogue.English: I see. It must have been very painful for you leading up to today's consultation...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 他にはどなたとご相談されていますか？
dialogue.English: Who else have you discussed this with?

dialogue.content: 夫と学校の先生です
dialogue.English: My husband and the school teachers.

dialogue.content: 夫さんは、どんな風にお嬢さんに接しておられるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How does your husband interact with your daughter?

dialogue.content: 最近はもう放っておいてます前は何度も叩いたり怒鳴っていました
dialogue.English: Lately, he's just been leaving her alone. Before, he used to hit her and yell at her many times.

dialogue.content: うんうん・・・そうでしたか。お辛いですね…
dialogue.English: I see... That must be difficult...

dialogue.content: はいわたしも叩いたこともあります
dialogue.English: Yes. I’ve hit her too.

dialogue.content: でも何をしても何を言っても何も言わないんです
dialogue.English: But no matter what we do or say, she doesn’t say anything.

dialogue.content: お母様ご自身も追い詰められたようなお気持ちになりますよね
dialogue.English: You must feel as if you're being cornered yourself.

dialogue.content: 言ってくれれば、とも思いますよね
dialogue.English: You probably wish she would just say something.

dialogue.content: 本当に大変です言わなきゃわからないのに言ってくれないんです
dialogue.English: It’s really hard. I can’t understand unless she tells me, but she won’t.

dialogue.content: 腹も立ちますよね
dialogue.English: It must be frustrating.

dialogue.content: はい、こんなに心配しているのに
dialogue.English: Yes, especially when I'm this worried.

dialogue.content: ええ、腹も立つし、心配もするし・・お嬢さんの事がとても大切だからですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, you feel frustrated, and you worry... and that's because your daughter is so important to you.

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That’s right.

dialogue.content: これまで、どれダメ胸を痛めてこられたのか、お察しいたします
dialogue.English: I can only imagine how much this has pained you all this time.

dialogue.content: わたし子供の頃すごく苦労して、、、娘はそんな風にしなくなくてなんでも与えてきたのに
dialogue.English: I had a very hard time when I was a child... I didn't want my daughter to go through that, so I gave her everything.

dialogue.content: ええ‥
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 何が不満なの？って思います
dialogue.English: I just wonder, "What is there to be unhappy about?"

dialogue.content: 精一杯やってこられたんですよね
dialogue.English: You've been doing your very best for her.

dialogue.content: 子供のために何でもしてきました
dialogue.English: I’ve done everything for my child.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 怠けているとしか思えないんですバイトは行くから、お金のことしか考えてないんです
dialogue.English: I can't help but think she's just being lazy. She goes to her part-time job, so all she thinks about is money.

dialogue.content: 欲しいものを買って、着飾ってとかそれしか考えてないんです
dialogue.English: All she thinks about is buying things she wants and dressing up.

dialogue.content: バイトには行っておられるんですね。2年生になって寝坊するようになったとのことでしたが、生活にはどんな変化がありましたか？
dialogue.English: So she does go to her part-time job. You mentioned she started oversleeping when she became a sophomore; were there any other changes in her life around that time?

dialogue.content: 夫と離婚の話をした頃かもしれません
dialogue.English: It might have been around the time my husband and I talked about divorce.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 夫とも色々あって、一度離婚したいと言いました娘も離婚すれば良かったのにと言っていました
dialogue.English: I had a lot of issues with my husband, and I once told him I wanted a divorce. My daughter even said she wished we had gotten divorced.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そのころから寝坊するようになったんですね
dialogue.English: I see, so that's when she started oversleeping.

dialogue.content: そう言えば、そうかもしれないです
dialogue.English: Now that you mention it, that might be the case.

dialogue.content: 2週間前からは登校もされなくなったとのことですが、そのあたりにはどんなことがありましたか？
dialogue.English: You said she stopped going to school two weeks ago. Did anything happen around that time?

dialogue.content: テストが始まる時で朝起こしに行ってわたしがちょっときつく叱りましたわたしもストレスだからいい加減にしてと
dialogue.English: It was when her exams were starting. I went to wake her up and scolded her a bit harshly. I told her I was stressed too and to get her act together.

dialogue.content: うんうん…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: それから、テストも行かずもうどうでもいいと、学校に行かなくなりました
dialogue.English: After that, she skipped her exams, said she didn't care anymore, and stopped going to school.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。いつも眠るのは何時ぐらいなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. What time does she usually go to sleep?

dialogue.content: 2時3時とか遅くまで起きてるみたいです朝起きれないのは当たり前です
dialogue.English: She stays up until 2 or 3 a.m., so of course she can't wake up in the morning.

dialogue.content: そんなに遅くては、朝起きられないのは納得ですね。私自身も、そんな生活で学校に間に合うようには起きられません・・・。
dialogue.English: Staying up that late, it's understandable that she can't wake up in the morning. Even I wouldn't be able to get up in time for school with that kind of schedule...

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Thank you very much!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Thank you very much!
